system.description: A thief in simple clothes with daggers, eager to prove themselves.
system.notes:
Normal | Minion

A thief in simple clothes with daggers, eager to prove themselves.
Motives & Tactics: Escape, profit, throw smoke

Difficulty: 9 | Thresholds: None | HP: 1 | Stress: 1

ATK: -2 | Weapon: Melee | 2 physical

Experience: Thief +2

Features

Minion (3) - Passive: The Lackey is defeated by any damage. For every 3 damage a PC deals to a Lackey, defeat one additional Minion within any range the same attack would have hit.

Group Attack - Action: Spend 1 Fear to pick a target and spotlight all Bandit Lackeys within Close range. Those Minions move into Melee with the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, each deals 2 physical damage. Combine the damage.
